verdict.rationale: Flagright's API reference names dedicated sandbox API servers in eu-1 and asia-1, with the sandbox as the default server. Endpoints for batch users, cases and alerts are all shown against sandbox.api.flagright.com, so integrators can test without hitting production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandbox data is isolated from production, guidance on provisioning sandbox credentials and moving to production, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
